server.title: Jeremy Twogood Portfolio
server.description: MCP server for Jeremy Twogood, Toronto video producer & editor. Projects, reel, resume, booking.

rateLimit: Action tools (send_message, book_call) are limited to 3 requests per IP per day.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get Jeremy Twogood's profile: bio, skills, clients, location, and social links.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all of Jeremy's work projects with metadata.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get full details for a single project, including video content description.

tools.name: list_ai_builds
tools.description: List all of Jeremy's AI and software projects.

tools.name: get_ai_build
tools.description: Get full details for a single AI or software project.

tools.name: get_reel
tools.description: Get Jeremy's showreel description and link.

tools.name: get_resume
tools.description: Get Jeremy's full structured resume as JSON.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Get Jeremy's booking URL and availability information.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to Jeremy by email. Requires agent_name (your identifier) and human_name (the person you represent). Rate limited to 3 action requests per IP per day.

tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Get a pre-filled Calendly booking link for a call with Jeremy. Requires agent_name and human_name. Rate limited to 3 action requests per IP per day.
